title: Trivial and free profinite action-parameter functors
statement: Let $J$ be a compact Hausdorff totally disconnected topological group in $\mathbf{Set}_u$, and let $P$ be the category of profinite sets in that universe [sk-def-sfb-condensed-ring]. Let $A_J$ be the category whose objects are profinite spaces with continuous left $J$-action and whose maps are continuous equivariant maps. Define $t_J:P\to A_J$ by giving $S$ its trivial action and retaining each continuous map. Define $H_J:P\to A_J$ by $H_J(S)=J\times S$, with action $g\cdot(j,s)=(gj,s)$, and $H_J(f)(j,s)=(j,f(s))$. Both constructions use the original topological spaces and continuous maps; the trivial-action construction needs only a topological group.
